MASTER-SAAO robotic telescope  [1]  located in South Africa (South African Astronomical Observatory) started inspect of the Fermi GRB 260718A ( A. Holzmann Airasca et al., GCN 45181) errorbox  30093 sec after notice time and 30129 sec after trigger time at 2026-07-18 19:38:45 UT, with upper limit up to  16.1 mag. The observations began at zenith distance = 79 deg. The sun  altitude  is -47.9 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = -70 deg., longitude l = 272 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3433050
